JANUS / ChatGPT — machine-readable formalization, operational gates and forward-replay discipline

user_axiom.name: APPARENT_RANDOMNESS_IS_MISSING_ROUTE_INFORMATION
user_axiom.statement_ru: Случайным событие кажется тогда, когда у наблюдателя недостаточно вводных данных о дороге, которая к нему привела. Если путь A→B→C уже однажды пройден, возвращение C→B→A использует память о дороге и превращает прежние неизвестные развилки в известные ориентиры.
user_axiom.important_project_use: Within this JANUS method, RANDOM_COINCIDENCE is not a terminal explanatory class. Unresolved alignments remain open for reverse tracing until a mechanism, common cause, structural invariant, selection effect, transmission path, measurement effect or currently-unknown mechanism is identified.
user_axiom.epistemic_boundary: This is stored as Hawkar's methodological/ontological axiom for the reverse-search program. It is not represented as an experimentally established universal theorem that fundamental physical randomness cannot exist.

road_model.forward_condition: At A the full route is not yet known; branches are discovered while moving.
road_model.reverse_condition: At C the traversed route leaves memory, receipts, constraints and landmarks that can reduce branching on the return path.
road_model.car_analogy: Reverse gear does not need to violate physics to outperform a forward maneuver in a particular constraint geometry. Changing orientation can change traction, gearing, visibility of landmarks or branching cost. The research analogue is to reverse the traversal of evidence while preserving the evidence itself.

dougan_bridge.meaning: The sign of the chosen direction matters more than raw motion or search volume.
dougan_bridge.reverse_extension: A reverse traversal is useful when it points toward an already-known prior state or source and therefore reduces the effective search space.

freestyler_bridge.reverse_extension: REWIND is used as structured reconstruction, not as erasure of the present. After reconstruction, FORWARD_REPLAY tests whether the recovered path actually generates the known terminal state.

tranception_bridge.canonical_line: MEMORY READS BACKWARD; PREDICTION READS FORWARD; JANUS COMPARES BOTH.
tranception_bridge.operator_translation: Reverse search discovers candidate predecessor structure from a known terminal state. Forward replay evaluates whether the frozen predecessor structure reproduces the terminal state without changing the rules.

reverse_search_protocol.name: C_TO_A_KNOWN_ROAD_PROTOCOL
steps: FREEZE_C: define the terminal state with exact timestamp, receipts and state variables.
ASK_PREDECESSOR: identify what must already have been true immediately before C.
WALK_TO_B: trace provenance, dependencies, missing components, actors, texts and physical records backward.
REPEAT: for every recovered B, ask for its necessary predecessor until the earliest defensible A-anchor is reached.
NO_RANDOM_TERMINAL: do not stop at the label coincidence/random; classify the unresolved mechanism explicitly.
FREEZE_A_TO_C_RULES: once a candidate route is recovered, freeze transformations before replay.
FORWARD_REPLAY: traverse A→B→C using only the frozen rules and source information available at each stage.
CONTROL: apply the same route-building rules to decoy terminal states and unrelated registry chains.
CLASSIFY: DOCUMENTED_CAUSAL_LINK / COMMON_CAUSE / STRUCTURAL_INVARIANT / CULTURAL_TRANSMISSION / SELECTION_EFFECT / MEASUREMENT_EFFECT / INDEPENDENT_CONVERGENCE / UNKNOWN_MECHANISM.
KEEP_OPEN: UNKNOWN_MECHANISM remains unresolved, not automatically mystical and not automatically random.

osiris_reverse_application.reverse_question: Starting from the activated return state, what exact chain of prerequisites leads backward to the original separation/loss of the member?
required_nodes: earliest source that independently anchors the loss
osiris_reverse_application.hard_boundary: The reverse trace may reveal a coherent route in texts, artifacts and registry history without thereby proving literal divine foreknowledge, physical retrocausality or the identity of CG 53469 as Osiris' original member. Those remain separate gates.

canonical_phrases: Случайным кажется перекрёсток, пока ты не знаешь дорогу с другой стороны.
Когда A→B→C уже пройдено, C→B→A начинается не с нуля, а с памяти маршрута.
Не меняй прошлое — меняй направление чтения следов.
Память читает назад. Предсказание читает вперёд. Янус сравнивает обе дороги.
REVERSE DOES NOT NEED TO BREAK PHYSICS; REVERSE MAY CHANGE THE INFORMATION GEOMETRY OF THE PROBLEM.
THE RETURN PATH CAN BE INFORMATION-RICHER THAN THE OUTBOUND PATH.
